steps.summary: On ticket RD-1017's detail page I used the 'Add part' action, filling the dialog's required fields (Part name *, Cost *, Markup % *; Quantity defaulted to 1 and Supplier left empty) with name 'fwrd80-n3 RD Part A', cost 100, markup 25, then submitted. The dialog closed, the parts table refreshed from its empty state to show the new part row, and a Total row appeared. The app computes and displays the price as $125.00 (100 × 1.25).

On ticket RD-1017's detail page I used the 'Add part' action, filling the dialog's required fields (Part name *, Cost *, Markup % *; Quantity defaulted to 1 and Supplier left empty) with name 'fwrd80-n3 RD Part A', cost 200, markup 25, then submitted. The dialog closed, the parts table refreshed from its empty state to show the new part row, and a Total row appeared. The app computes and displays the price as $250.00 (100 × 1.25).

On ticket RD-1017's detail page I used the Edit action on the 'fwrd80-n3 RD Part A' row, which opened an "Edit part" dialog pre-filled with that part (name, cost 100, markup 25, qty 1, supplier blank). I changed only Cost to 150, left Markup % at 25, and clicked "Save part". The dialog closed and the parts table refreshed in place: Part A now shows cost $150.00, markup 25%, qty 1, and the app-computed price $187.50; the ticket's parts total updated to $437.50. Part B is unchanged at $200.00 / 25% / $250.00.

steps.summary: On RD-1017 I used Delete on 'fwrd80-n3 RD Part A' and confirmed the in-page dialog (heading "Confirm", buttons "Cancel"/"Delete part"); the table refreshed to show only Part B and the total dropped to $250.00. I then did the same for 'fwrd80-n3 RD Part B' and the parts table became empty ('No parts on this ticket yet.', Total row gone). I then clicked 'Archive ticket' — it was ACCEPTED with no refusal message and no confirmation dialog appeared; the button changed to 'Unarchive ticket'. The detail page now shows Status: Ready with an "Archived" badge. The ticket no longer appears in the active tickets list (unchecked "Show archived" + search 'fwrd80-n3' → "No tickets match the current filters."), and reappears only when "Show archived" is ticked, as "RD-1017 | fwrd80-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-21".
